contributes.configuration.properties.clP: Enable F4=Prompt for CL commands
Show CL Command Entry after an IBM i connection is established.
On demand only: do not auto-show CL Command Entry. Open it manually with CLPROMPTER: Open CL Command Entry when needed.
Controls when the CL Command Entry panel is auto-shown. The On Demand option means manual open only, not never available.

Default SQL job mode for Command Entry when a connection does not yet have its own saved cmdEntry.sharedSQLJob value. True = Use Shared SQL Job, false = Use Private SQL Job. After you switch mode from the Command Entry menu, that per-connection setting is saved and takes precedence over this default.
Enable incremental SQL row loading for CL Command Entry statements using `Cmd Entry SQL Fetch Row Limit`. Uncheck this setting for a Fetch Limit of *NOMAX rows (fetch all rows on run).

Controls the maximum number of rows per fetch request when `cmdEntryLimitSqlFetch` is checked. Ignored when that setting is unchecked (*NOMAX rows). Higher values can improve result set performance on fast IBM i servers.
Rows fetched for the first page only when a SQL statement is run from Command Entry. After first-page display, additional loads use cmdEntrySqlFetchRowLimit.
Enable debug diagnostic logging for CL Command Entry internals (job routing, keep-alive, and SQL execution detail).
Expand command-level message sections by default in Command Entry log.
Collapse command-level message sections by default in Command Entry log.
Controls whether Command Entry log entries are expanded or collapsed. Use F10 to toggle anytime.
Color of CL command text shown in Command Entry Log and History rows. Use CSS color values like #3794ff, blue, or rgb(52, 120, 246).
Color of SQL statement text shown in Command Entry Log and History rows when SQL statements are logged. Use CSS color values like #3794ff, blue, or rgb(52, 120, 246).
Clear Command Entry panel history and message log when the CLPROMPTER extension starts.
When true, retrieval of Command Entry history is limited to the active connection. When false (default), Command Entry history is shared across connections.
Record CL commands run from Command Entry into History (used by F8/F9 and arrow-keys for retrieval).
Record SQL statements run from Command Entry into History.
Record SQL statements run from Command Entry into Log.
Record Snippets run from Command Entry into History.
Record Snippets run from Command Entry into Log.
Run the selected Code Snippet.
Open the fully resolved Code Snippet text in an editor tab.
Do nothing when a Code Snippet node is clicked.
Controls what happens when you click a Code Snippet in the tree view (setting key: clPrompter.cmdEntryCodeSnippetTreeClickAction).
PARM keyword color in prompter.  Use CSS color values like ##1a237e, blue, or rgb(34,170,34).
PARM value color in prompter.  Use CSS color values like ##1a237e, blue, or rgb(34,170,34).
PARM keyword color Auto-adjust for best contrast in dark/light/high-contrast themes. If false, uses your color exactly as specified.
Write prompted command XML to clp_cmdDefn_<cmdName>.xml. Useful for troubleshooting but not recommended for normal use.
Directory where clp_cmdDefn_<cmdName>.xml is written when clPrompter.saveCmdXMLToFile is enabled. Enter *TMPDIR, *USERHOME, *WORKSPACE, or an absolute path.
Save prompter HTML to clp_cmdPrompt_<cmdName>.html for diagnostic purposes. This file can be sent to support for troubleshooting issues with the prompter.
Directory where clp_cmdPrompt_<cmdName>.html is written when clPrompter.saveCmdPrompterHTMLToFile is enabled. Enter *TMPDIR, *USERHOME, *WORKSPACE, or an absolute path.
Save command parameter helptext to clp_cmdHelpText_<cmdName>_<parmName>.html for diagnostic purposes when reporting issues.
Directory where clp_cmdHelpText_<cmdName>_<parmName>.html is written when clPrompter.saveCmdHelpTextToFile is enabled. Enter *TMPDIR, *USERHOME, *WORKSPACE, or an absolute path.

Convert CL variables, operators (*BCAT, *TCAT, etc.), and built-in functions (%SUBST, %TRIM, etc.) within PARM values to uppercase. When true, text like '&pickles *bcat %trim(&x)' becomes '&PICKLES *BCAT %TRIM(&X)'. When false, preserves original case. Applies when returning from the prompter.

Case conversion for CL command names and PARM keywords. *UPPER = uppercase (CHGVAR VAR(...)), *LOWER = lowercase (chgvar var(...)), *NONE = no change. Applies when returning from the prompter and when formatting CL source.
Indent comments. *YES = indent comments, *NO = leave at column 1.
Position of the optional command label (1-10 characters followed by colon). Default: 2.
Position where the CL command name starts. Must be at least 1 space after the label. Default: 14.
Position where the first PARM/keyword starts. Use 0 for one space after command name. Default: 25.
Position where continuation lines start. Normally 2 positions after formatKwdPosition. Default: 27.
Last position where data or continuation symbols (+ or -) may appear. Default: 72.
Maximum number of characters a prompted input field can be expanded to by entering & and leaving the field. Default: 5000.
Number of characters added to a prompted input field each time the user enters & and leaves the field. Default: 16.
Comma- or space-delimited list of CL command names to pre-load when a connection to IBM i is established. For each command, both the Prompter and helptext are prefetched. Leave blank to disable.

Library on IBM i where clPrompter UDTFs such as CHECK_SYNTAX and CMD_HELP are installed. *TEMPLIB = use Code for IBM i's configured temporary library. Recommended SQLTOOLS or SYSTOOLS. Or enter any user library name. Default: *TEMPLIB.
Fast SQL-based helptext via the CMD_HELP UDTF (once installed on IBM i). Requires the CMD_HELP UDTF in the library specified by clPrompter.helpLibrary.
Legacy Helptext generated via the GENCMDDOC CL command. (slow).
Interface to use to retrieve CL command parameter helptext when the ? button is clicked in the prompter.
